parts:
Hello all,

Tomorrow - at 1 pm in Wickson 2124 - Lindsay Henderson will be presenting on some heirarchical mixed model results she is looking for feedback on:

Description:

My experiment used a repeated measure design to investigate predatory fishes' behaviour under three chemosensory treatments. I wanted to assess whether fish spent different amounts of time in different parts of their tank (defined as 3 zones), or whether they behaved differently within each zone dependent upon the chemosensory treatment experienced. To analyse these data I used hierarchical mixed models, and I found a significant interaction between chemosensory treatment and zone. I would like to understand how to use post-hoc tests to interpret this result.

Hope to see you there,
Stella
